cases.explain: Ангел is the subject of the sentence, requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Звезде был дан ключ от колодца ___.
cases.translation: The key to the pit of the abyss was given to the star.
cases.explain: After the preposition от (from/of), the genitive case is required.

cases.translation: The sun and sky darkened from the smoke.
cases.explain: Небо is part of a compound subject with солнце (sun), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Саранче была дана власть, какую имеют на земле ___.
cases.translation: The locusts were given power like that of scorpions.
cases.explain: After the verb имеют (have), the nominative case is used for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Ей было запрещено причинять вред земной траве и любому ___.
cases.translation: It was forbidden to harm the grass and any tree.
cases.explain: The verb вредить takes the dative case for the thing being harmed.

cases.sentence: И люди мучились от боли, которая была как от укусов ___.
cases.translation: People suffered torment like from the sting of a scorpion.
cases.explain: After the preposition от (from), the genitive case is required.

cases.sentence: Саранча была похожа на боевых коней, готовых к ___.
cases.translation: The locusts looked like war horses prepared for battle.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) always takes the dative case.

cases.translation: Over them was the angel of the abyss as king.
cases.explain: Ангел is the subject of the predicate, taking the nominative case.

reading.ru: Я увидел звезду, упавшую с неба на землю.
reading.question: What did John see fall from heaven to earth?
reading.explain: The text says 'Я увидел звезду, упавшую с неба на землю' — he saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth.

reading.ru: Из дыма вышла на землю саранча, которой дана была власть, какую имеют на земле скорпионы.
reading.question: What came out of the smoke onto the earth, and what power was given to it?
reading.explain: The text states 'саранча... дана была власть, какую имеют на земле скорпионы' — locusts were given power like that of scorpions.

reading.ru: В те дни люди будут искать смерти и не смогут ее найти.
reading.question: What will people seek but not find in those days?
reading.explain: The text says 'люди будут искать смерти и не смогут ее найти' — people will seek death but will not be able to find it.

reading.ru: Саранча была похожа на боевых коней, готовых к сражению.
reading.question: What did the locusts look like?
reading.explain: The text states 'Саранча была похожа на боевых коней, готовых к сражению' — the locusts looked like war horses prepared for battle.

reading.ru: Его звали по-еврейски Авадон, а по-гречески Аполеон, Губитель.
reading.question: What was the name of the king of the abyss in Hebrew and Greek?
options: Abaddon in Hebrew and Apollyon in Greek
Michael in Hebrew and Gabriel in Greek
Satan in Hebrew and Lucifer in Greek
Belial in Hebrew and Abyss in Greek
reading.correct: Abaddon in Hebrew and Apollyon in Greek
reading.explain: The text says 'его звали по-еврейски Авадон, а по-гречески Аполеон' — his name in Hebrew was Abaddon and in Greek was Apollyon.

reading.ru: Затрубил шестой ангел, и я услышал голос, раздававшийся от четырех рогов золотого жертвенника.
reading.question: What did the sixth angel do and what did John hear?
options: The sixth angel sounded and he heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar
The sixth angel wept and shadows covered the earth
The sixth angel flew high and thunder echoed
The sixth angel descended and the stars fell
reading.correct: The sixth angel sounded and he heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar
reading.explain: The text states 'Затрубил шестой ангел, и я услышал голос, раздававшийся от четырех рогов золотого жертвенника' — the sixth angel sounded and a voice came from the altar.
